description: This PHP class 'GoteoDonors' defines migration tasks for updating the schema and data of the 'donor' table in a database within a project. It contains methods to generate SQL statements for both applying ('up' migration) and reverting ('down' migration) schema changes and data updates related to donor certificate files and confirmation status.

classes.name: GoteoDonors
classes.description: A class responsible for defining database migration SQL for the 'donor' table, including pre- and post- hooks for migration steps, and methods to generate SQL for migrating 'up' and 'down'.

methods.name: preUp
methods.description: Placeholder method for code to execute before applying the 'up' migration.

methods.name: postUp
methods.description: Placeholder method for code to execute after applying the 'up' migration.

methods.name: preDown
methods.description: Placeholder method for code to execute before reverting the migration.

methods.name: postDown
methods.description: Placeholder method for code to execute after reverting the migration.

methods.name: getUpSQL
methods.description: Returns SQL statements to update the 'donor' table: setting default values, changing column definitions, adding 'processed' column, and updating 'processed' dates for confirmed donors.

methods.name: getDownSQL
methods.description: Returns SQL statements to revert the schema changes: dropping 'processed' column and restoring original column definitions for 'edited', 'confirmed', and 'pdf'.
